---
pagetitle: "Crime Without Consequence handout charts"
body-classes: handout
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(csgjcr)
library(highcharter)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(reactable)

source("R/page-data.R")
source("R/utils.R")
source("analysis/crime_wo_conseq/helpers.R")

# htmlwidgets seeds its element IDs from this, so rerenders give identical HTML
set.seed(2019)
```

```{r}
### interactive versions of the Crime Without Consequence handout's charts,
### pages 1-5, national only
handout_source <- "CSG Justice Center analysis of FBI Uniform Crime Reporting (UCR) Program data"
missing_2021_note <- "* Missing 2021 data. Illinois has no reliable clearance data."

### page 1 uses the site's backlog charts, built as on index.qmd, with the
### trend chart in black and gray
srs_state_new <- read_srs_state()
first_year <- max(srs_state_new$year) - 10
solve_coverage <- read_solve_coverage()
us_backlog_charts <- backlog_charts(
  add_backlog(us_solve_trend(srs_state_new, first_year), solve_coverage),
  add_backlog(us_solve_trend(srs_state_new, first_year, by_offense = TRUE), solve_coverage),
  "the U.S.",
  trend_colors = c(reported = site_colors[["text"]], solved = site_colors[["text"]], unsolved = site_colors[["gray_pale"]])
)

### pages 2-4 use the handout's own series, from analysis/crime_wo_conseq
national <- read_national()
recent <- recent_years(national)
states <- read_states() |>
  mutate(
    pct = if_else(no_data, NA_real_, pct_solved),
    star = if_else(year_missing & !no_data, "*", "")
  )

### hex map of states, as on index.qmd
hex_gj <- sf::read_sf("data/us_states_hexgrid.geojson") |>
  select(state_abb = iso3166_2) |>
  sf::st_transform(3857) |>
  geojsonsf::sf_geojson() |>
  jsonlite::fromJSON(simplifyVector = FALSE)

no_data_tooltip <- function(name) paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>No reliable clearance data")
```

## Page 1

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.5
us_backlog_charts$trend |>
  hc_chart_title("Violent Crime Reported, Solved, and Unsolved in the U.S., 2020–2025")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.5
us_backlog_charts$backlog |>
  hc_chart_title("Backlog of Unsolved Violent Crime, 2020–2025")
```

## Page 2

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
solved_map_colors <- setNames(
  site_colors[c("text", "gray_dark", "gray_mid", "gray_light", "white")],
  solved_share_classes
)

states |>
  transmute(
    state_abbr, state_name,
    class = solved_share_class(pct),
    label = if_else(no_data, "—", solved_label(pct, year_missing)),
    tooltip = if_else(
      no_data, no_data_tooltip(state_name),
      paste0("<b>", state_name, "</b><br>Share of violent crimes solved, 2020–2025: ", label,
             if_else(year_missing, "<br>* Leaves out 2021, which lacks reliable data", ""))
    )
  ) |>
  state_class_map(
    hex_gj, solved_map_colors,
    title = "Share of Violent Crimes Solved, 2020–2025",
    caption = paste(missing_2021_note, handout_source, sep = "<br>"),
    description = paste(
      "Hex map of the share of violent crimes solved in each state, 2020 to 2025, in four groups:",
      "40% or less, 41 to 49%, 50 to 59%, and 60% or more. Illinois has no reliable data."
    ),
    dark_classes = c("40% or less", "41–49%")
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
unsolved_map_colors <- setNames(site_colors[c("text", "white", "gray_light")], unsolved_share_classes)

states |>
  transmute(
    state_abbr, state_name,
    class = unsolved_share_class(pct),
    label = if_else(no_data, "—", paste0(round(100 * (1 - pct)), "%", star)),
    tooltip = if_else(
      no_data, no_data_tooltip(state_name),
      paste0("<b>", state_name, "</b><br>Share of violent crimes unsolved, 2020–2025: ", label,
             if_else(year_missing, "<br>* Leaves out 2021, which lacks reliable data", ""))
    )
  ) |>
  state_class_map(
    hex_gj, unsolved_map_colors,
    title = "Share of Violent Crimes Unsolved, 2020–2025",
    caption = paste(missing_2021_note, handout_source, sep = "<br>"),
    description = paste(
      "Hex map of the share of violent crimes left unsolved in each state, 2020 to 2025,",
      "split into states where more than half went unsolved and states where half or fewer did.",
      "Illinois has no reliable data."
    ),
    dark_classes = "More than half unsolved"
  )
```

```{r}
### "≥" marks a count that leaves out a year without reliable data
at_least_cell <- function(flag) {
  function(value, index) {
    if (is.na(value)) return(na_text)
    paste0(if (flag[index]) "≥ " else "", comma(value))
  }
}

state_table <- states |>
  transmute(
    state_name,
    unsolved = if_else(no_data, NA_real_, unsolved),
    homicide_unsolved = if_else(no_data, NA_real_, homicide_unsolved),
    flag = year_missing & !no_data,
    homicide_flag = homicide_year_missing & !no_data
  ) |>
  arrange(state_name)

### the note prints with the table, so the space after graphics falls below it
table <- state_table |>
  select(state_name, unsolved, homicide_unsolved) |>
  reactable_template(
    sort_col = "state_name",
    columns = list(
      state_name = sticky_name_column("State"),
      unsolved = colDef(name = "Unsolved violent crimes, 2020–2025", cell = at_least_cell(state_table$flag)),
      homicide_unsolved = colDef(name = "Unsolved homicides, 2020–2025", cell = at_least_cell(state_table$homicide_flag))
    )
  )

htmltools::tagList(
  table,
  htmltools::p(
    class = "table-note",
    "States marked ≥ leave out 2021, which lacks reliable clearance data, so their counts are a minimum.",
    "New York's 2022 homicide clearances are also left out.",
    "A dash means Illinois, which has no reliable clearance data.",
    paste0("Source: ", handout_source, ".")
  )
)
```

## Page 3

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.5
periods(filter(national, year >= 1966), 5) |>
  period_stacked_chart(
    title = "Violent Crime Solved and Unsolved in the U.S., 1966–2025",
    subtitle = "Average violent crimes reported per year, by 5-year period",
    caption = paste0(handout_source, "<br>Figures for 1966–1978 compiled by Crime Index."),
    description = paste(
      "Stacked column chart of the average number of violent crimes reported per year in each",
      "5-year period from 1966 to 2025, split into solved and unsolved, with each period's solve rate."
    )
  )
```

## Page 4

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
us_crime_rate <- pooled_crime_rate(states)
us_solve_pct <- 100 * pooled_solve_rate(recent)

states |>
  filter(!no_data) |>
  transmute(
    reported_per_100k, unsolved,
    solve_pct = 100 * pct,
    label = paste0(state_abbr, star),
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", state_name, "</b><br>",
      "Violent crimes reported per 100,000 residents per year: ", comma(reported_per_100k), "<br>",
      "Share solved: ", solved_label(pct, year_missing), "<br>",
      "Unsolved violent crimes, 2020–2025: ", if_else(year_missing, "≥ ", ""), comma(unsolved),
      if_else(year_missing, "<br>* Leaves out 2021, which lacks reliable data", "")
    )
  ) |>
  state_solve_scatter(
    us_crime_rate, us_solve_pct,
    title = "Share of Violent Crimes Solved and Violent Crime Rate by State, 2020–2025",
    subtitle = "Circle size shows unsolved violent crimes, 2020–2025",
    caption = paste(
      "* Solve rate excludes 2021 because of unreliable clearance data. Illinois has no reliable clearance data.",
      handout_source, sep = "<br>"
    ),
    description = paste0(
      "Bubble chart of each state's violent crime rate against its share of violent crimes solved, 2020 to 2025, ",
      "with circles sized by unsolved violent crimes. Dashed lines mark the U.S. rate of ", comma(us_crime_rate),
      " violent crimes per 100,000 residents and the U.S. solve rate of ", round(us_solve_pct), "%."
    )
  )
```

## Page 5

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
### the handout's national series, pooled by period as on page 3
clearance_periods <- periods(filter(national, year >= 1971), 5) |>
  mutate(rate = 100 * pct_solved)
crime_index_years <- range(filter(national, year >= 1971, count_source == "Crime Index")$year)

period_rate_chart(
  clearance_periods,
  title = "Average Violent Crime Solve Rate by Five-Year Period, 1971–2025",
  caption = paste0(handout_source, "<br>Figures for ", crime_index_years[1], "–", crime_index_years[2], " compiled by Crime Index."),
  description = "Column chart of the share of violent crimes solved in each 5-year period from 1971 to 2025."
)
```
